title: Local browser bridge and MCP command routing

checkpoint.summary: Implemented a generic, persistent, one-shot JarvisClient browser scheduler in commit 7ef47e4. MCP ScheduleBrowserExecution/ListScheduledBrowserExecutions/CancelScheduledBrowserExecution schedule an open-tab+project-script action by ID and delay. Jobs survive client restart; the client marks a job running before dispatch, never replays uncertain work, and needs no watchdog or agent-specific role state. Tab aliases can be generated uniquely. Browser consent remains extension-controlled.
checkpoint.nextAction: Independent code review and real Edge acceptance: pair extension, manually register an origin, opt into agent-created tabs, schedule a short new-tab execution from a real project JavaScript file, verify it runs once and persists across client restart, and check revoke/cancel. Then integrate and deploy coordinated server/client/extension if accepted. No rollout yet.
